Chapter 1230: Chapter 37 Invincible Venerable ’Galaxy’ (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan stood in the void, resembling an eternal Fierce Sun shining, and as the Divine Ability ’World’ operated, one Peak Venerable after another was extinguished and fell.

In no time, the surrounding heavens and earth were completely clear, leaving only numerous weapons, treasures, and rare items floating around.

"Before stepping into the Chaos Realm, my strength was on the same tier as the Strongest Venerables like Fu Xu Venerate, perhaps only slightly stronger. But after entering the Chaos Realm, the essence of my life transformed. The so-called Strongest Venerable? Simply no match for me."

Lin Yuan thought to himself that if not for the fact that time and space operated independently within the treasure ground, long-term activation of Divine Ability ’World’ would conflict with the time flow inside it.

Thus affecting the future nurturing of rare treasures within the treasure ground.

Lin Yuan did not need to refine each core heavenly pillar; he could directly envelop the entire treasure ground with his external universe.

It was only when Fu Xu Venerate and the numerous Peak Venerables scattered and fled that Lin Yuan temporarily suppressed them with his external universe.

Due to the short time of Divine Ability World’s activation and Lin Yuan’s carefulness, it had no impact on the treasure ground.

"Phew!"

Lin Yuan slightly moved his mind, retracted his external universe, and also collected the spoils left by the numerous Peak Venerables.

This time, having demonstrated strength beyond the six Ancient Countries’ understanding, Lin Yuan was already prepared with explanations, attributing it to the ancestor bloodline at the Venerate level.

As the first in this source world to excavate the ancestor bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level, besides Lin Yuan, no other venerate knew the effect of excavating the ancestor bloodline to this level.

Isn’t everything for Lin Yuan to decide?

As for when the second Heavenly Venerate level ancestor bloodline will be born... who knows how many millennia that will take. By that time, even if Lin Yuan hasn’t reached the thirteenth tier, he would be deep in a time loop, unaffected by the outside world.

In fact, even without using the Heavenly Venerate level ancestor bloodline as an excuse, no one dared to question Lin Yuan.

The six Ancient Countries upheld strength supremacy, and with the power Lin Yuan displayed, without the ancestor’s intervention he was invincible, so those Strongest Venerables would not dare appear before him.

As for the ancestor? The ancestors remain above all, Lin Yuan’s strength surpasses the Strongest Venerables, but to the thirteenth-tier ancestor, he is just a larger ant, not worthy of much attention.

Currently, everything Lin Yuan possesses, except for the Myriad Realms Gate, would not draw attention from the ancestors.

Thirteenth-tier inheritance? It originates from the ancestors.

Thirteenth-tier weapons? The ancestors also possess them.

Whizz.

Lin Yuan briefly examined the spoils left by the Peak Venerables and then stepped forward, appearing before the Red Flame Venerate.

"Galaxy, Galaxy Venerate." Red Flame Venerate was shocked, barely suppressing his emotions, looking at Lin Yuan with a respectful and humble attitude: "I never imagined that your strength, Galaxy Venerate, would be so powerful, sweeping Fu Xu Venerate and numerous top Peak Venerables with your own might. When the emperor mentioned you, I had my doubts, but now it seems I was foolish."

Red Flame Venerate felt a bit ashamed thinking about how he once ’disdained’ Galaxy Venerate, and a sense of fear welled up within him.

"It’s nothing."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

Red Flame Venerate really had no personal agenda; his doubts about Lin Yuan’s strength were for the sake of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, after all, competing for a precious treasure ground, the participating Venerate’s strength must be up to par.

If any participating Venerate became a liability, leading to the failure of acquiring the treasure ground, it would be detrimental to the entire Ancient Country.

After Lin Yuan sparred with Red Lotus Venerate to prove his strength, Red Flame Venerate didn’t have more to say.

"Hmm?"

At this moment, Red Flame Venerate glanced up, suddenly seeing over a dozen figures appearing in the distance, which were the twelve Peak Venerables from the Barbaric Wilderness Country.

Upon sensing the battle here, more accurately, the one-sided crushing by Galaxy Venerate, the Peak Venerables from the Barbaric Wilderness Country had no choice but to come over, though it was hard to believe.

If they didn’t come, would they wait for Galaxy Venerate to come to them?

"Galaxy Venerate!"

Man Kun Venerate was shocked, through sensing the aura, he knew Fu Xu Venerate and many top Peak Venerables were swept by Galaxy Venerate.

It was an absolute sweep. As strong as Fu Xu Venerate was, he was utterly crushed in front of Galaxy Venerate.

Man Kun Venerate, although he didn’t like Fu Xu Venerate, had to admit the latter’s strength.

"Man Kun."

Lin Yuan likewise glanced at Man Kun Venerate.

The core heavenly pillars occupied by the Barbaric Wilderness Country were mostly concentrated in the upper region of the treasure ground.

When Lin Yuan started pushing from the corner, he hadn’t encountered any core heavenly pillars occupied and refined by the Barbaric Wilderness Country.

"Galaxy Venerate, our Barbaric Wilderness Country is willing to hand over all the core heavenly pillars." Man Kun Venerate immediately stated.

Having seen the end that befell the other Ancient Countries’ Peak Venerables, with their main combat bodies falling one after another, under such circumstances, handing over the core heavenly pillars honestly was the right choice.

At least they could preserve their main combat bodies.

And also the gains of the past one or two thousand years in this treasure ground; those golden mists were collected significantly by the Absolute Venerables of Barbaric Wilderness Country.

"Alright, you can leave now."

Lin Yuan nodded, not making it difficult for Man Kun Venerate.

Against Peak Venerables from Xuanyin Country, Da Ling Country, and other countries, he left no room for leniency because they were hostile toward Fierce Sun Ancient Country, even demanding sky-high prices for dozens of core heavenly pillars.

"Thank you, Galaxy Venerate."

Man Kun Venerate was slightly relieved.

At least in this treasure ground contest, the Absolute Venerables of Barbaric Wilderness Country had some gains and weren’t at a loss.

Compared to Fu Xu Venerate, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, and Spirit Prison Venerate, et cetera, Barbaric Wilderness Country fared relatively better.
